clips.title: The story
paras: The Deepwater Tavern is the bustling seaside inn of Menethil Harbor, nestled in the damp marshlands of the Wetlands. It serves as the primary meeting spot, resupply point, and resting place for travelers and mariners navigating the busy port town. Between hearty drinks and harbor rumors, patrons frequently find work or run into volatile tavern brawls.

Standing within the sodden streets of Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern offers travelers a welcome shelter from the perpetually drizzly, treacherous marshlands outside. Sailors, dockworkers, merchants, and weary adventurers gather beneath its timber beams to trade news, share a warm fire, and patch their wounds. Beyond the usual amenities of a harbor inn, it houses a resident first aid trainer and local merchants catering to those bound for the perils of the marsh or embarking across the Great Sea. The atmosphere is boisterous and occasionally hazardous; disputes flare up quickly over spilled ale, with notorious troublemakers like Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn known to spark the occasional tavern-wide brawl.
